records.en: ◆ Pupils can graduate when their education is completed.
◆After graduating, Pupils will receive Earnings and item rewards. Earnings are determined by Caretaker Intimacy, education, Pupil Intellect, and the Pupil’s Type.
◆ Certain Fellow Talents and family member Relationship Skills can also improve Earnings.
◆ This represents a Pupil's education potential, and is determined by their relationship with their Caretaker. The higher a Pupil's Intellect, the higher their Earnings will be.
◆ This represents the natural characteristics of a Pupil.
◆ Pupil Education: The higher your Rank, the better the educate methods and the higher Pupil Earnings will be.

◆ Pupils consume Education Points when in class. Attending class will increase a Pupil educational progress and earn the player Fellow EXP. The higher the player's Rank, the more experience will be gained.
◆ Education Points recover at a rate of 1 point every 5 minutes. Items may also be used to obtain Education Points.
